mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises > 50k in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls >0.2pp and PAYEMS rises >50k, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST above 1400k units), rising housing starts signal increased construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1400k, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400k units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1400k for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 6.0%), persistent inflation pressures lead to expectations of prolonged monetary tightening, which depresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 6.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) relative to its 12-month average indicates improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below its 12-month average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
